chapters.title: Chapter 6 — Adding endings
chapters.focus: adding ed, ing, er, est: drop the e, double the letter
chapters.description: Children learn how a word changes when ed, ing, er or est is added, such as dropping an e or doubling the last letter.

meaning.definition: To go past, or to hand something to someone.
meaning.example: Please pass me the salt at lunch.

meaning.definition: A living thing that grows in soil.
meaning.example: We water the plant on the windowsill.

meaning.definition: A narrow way for walking.
meaning.example: The path goes through the park.

meaning.definition: A big tub you sit in to get clean.
meaning.example: I have a warm bath before bed.

meaning.definition: One of two equal parts.
meaning.example: I ate half of the apple.

meaning.definition: Sixty minutes.
meaning.example: We played in the garden for an hour.

meaning.definition: Moved along in small jumps.
meaning.example: The rabbit hopped across the grass.

meaning.definition: Cooking food in an oven.
meaning.example: Gran is baking a cake for tea.

meaning.definition: Larger than something else.
meaning.example: My dog is bigger than the cat.

meaning.definition: Larger than all the others.
meaning.example: That is the biggest pumpkin in the shop.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 — Odd a and o
chapters.focus: a after w and qu; o for the u sound
chapters.description: Children learn that a after w or qu sounds like o, and that o can sound like u.

meaning.definition: To go from one place to another.
meaning.example: Please move your bag off the seat.

meaning.definition: To show that something is true.
meaning.example: I can prove that I can swim.

meaning.definition: To get better at something.
meaning.example: I want to improve my reading.

meaning.definition: Certain about something.
meaning.example: I am sure it is time for lunch.

meaning.definition: A sweet food used in cakes and drinks.
meaning.example: Mum put sugar in the cake mix.

meaning.definition: The clear liquid we drink.
meaning.example: I drink a glass of water each morning.

meaning.definition: Coins and notes used to buy things.
meaning.example: I save my money in a jar.

meaning.definition: To wish for something.
meaning.example: I want a drink of juice.

meaning.definition: To press something hard until it goes flat.
meaning.example: Do not squash the sandwiches in your bag.

meaning.definition: A boy who has the same parents as you.
meaning.example: My brother and I built a sandcastle.

chapters.title: Chapter 8 — Word endings
chapters.description: Children practise adding the endings ment, ness, ful, less and ly to root words.

meaning.definition: Was able to do something.
meaning.example: I could see the moon last night.

meaning.definition: A word for what is the right thing to do.
meaning.example: We should wash our hands before dinner.

meaning.definition: A word for what might happen.
meaning.example: I would like a biscuit please.

meaning.definition: A word used to ask which person.
meaning.example: Who is knocking at the door?

meaning.definition: All of something, with nothing left out.
meaning.example: I ate the whole sandwich.

meaning.definition: The part of the face you see with.
meaning.example: I got a speck of dust in my eye.

meaning.definition: Money that you give to buy something.
meaning.example: Dad made the payment at the shop.

meaning.definition: Being nice and caring to other people.
meaning.example: She showed kindness to the new girl.

meaning.definition: Taking care so that nothing gets broken or spilt.
meaning.example: Carry the eggs carefully to the table.

meaning.definition: Very clean, without a single mark.
meaning.example: After tidying, my room was spotless.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 — The tion ending
chapters.description: Children learn that the sh sound at the end of a word is often spelt tion.

meaning.definition: One or some, no matter which.
meaning.example: Do you have any crayons?

meaning.definition: A lot of.
meaning.example: There are many stars in the sky tonight.

meaning.definition: The things you wear.
meaning.example: I put my clothes on the chair.

meaning.definition: Having a lot to do; full of activity.
meaning.example: Mum is busy cooking dinner right now.

meaning.definition: One more time.
meaning.example: Can we sing the song again?

meaning.definition: A word that gives the reason for something.
meaning.example: I am happy because it is my birthday.

meaning.definition: A place where trains stop for people to get on.
meaning.example: We waited for the train at the station.

meaning.definition: Something that you do.
meaning.example: Clapping is a happy action.

meaning.definition: A soft cream you rub on your skin.
meaning.example: Mum put lotion on my arms.

meaning.definition: A magic drink in a story.
meaning.example: The wizard mixed a bubbly green potion.

chapters.title: Chapter 10 — Tall a words
chapters.focus: a before l and ll (all, walk, always)
chapters.description: Children learn that a before l or ll often sounds like or, as in all, walk and always.

meaning.definition: What you open to go into a room.
meaning.example: Please shut the door behind you.

meaning.definition: The part of a room that you walk on.
meaning.example: The toys are all over the floor.

meaning.definition: Having very little money.
meaning.example: The story is about a poor farmer.

meaning.definition: A short word put before a man's name.
meaning.example: Mr Green is my teacher.

meaning.definition: A short word put before a married lady's name.
meaning.example: Mrs Patel is waiting at the gate.

meaning.definition: A mum and dad, or those who look after a child.
meaning.example: My parents take me to school.

meaning.definition: The festival on 25 December when people give presents.
meaning.example: We hang a star on the tree at Christmas.

meaning.definition: Little; not big.
meaning.example: A small mouse ran under the bed.

meaning.definition: To move along on your feet.
meaning.example: We walk to the park after lunch.

meaning.definition: At all times, every single time.
meaning.example: I always brush my teeth at night.
